title: Claudio TDCG plan
description: An object with title, status, goal and cycles: the plan for a piece of work.

$schema.description: Text: where editors find this schema, e.g. "./plan.schema.json".

title.description: Letters, digits and single spaces only. Becomes the file name in .tdcg/done/.

goal.description: What we build and why, in a few lines. Not empty.

cycles.description: A list of at least one cycle, in order. The current one is the first with done: false.

key.description: A number from 1, optionally with one lowercase letter: "1", "2", "2b". Unique.

what.description: What this cycle builds, in a few words. Not empty.

done.description: true or false. Set by the tool after COMMIT, never by hand.

notes.description: A list of text: details and edge cases, enough to start SPECIFY. The tool also adds a line here when the user skips a phase.

files.description: A list of at least one file pattern this cycle may change, e.g. "tdcg/core/*.py". Paths start from the project folder.

type.description: One of "behaviour", "coverage", "refactor", "documentation", "setup", "spike". Optional, default "behaviour". Sets the cycle's phases: "behaviour" and "coverage" start with tests (RED); the others go SPECIFY → PROMPT → GREEN with tests locked.
